title: Myocardial metabolism in heart failure (Biobank)
summary: By establishing a biobank that integrates blood, urine, stool, and tissue samples, the goal is to identify pathophysiological biochemical mechanisms and potential biomarkers in various fields of research related to heart failure.
conditions: Male and female patients aged ≥ 18 years with various forms of heart failure

interventions.name: Male and female patients aged ≥ 18 years with various forms of heart failure (symptomatic/asymptomatic, preserved/impaired ejection fraction, with/without a cardiac assist device, before/after heart transplantation)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•    Age ≥ 18 years
•    Male and female patients with asymptomatic or symptomatic heart failure with reduced or preserved ejection fraction (based on diagnosis and/or echocardiographic findings), or who have a history of cardiac assist device implantation or heart transplantation
•    Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
•   Lack of consent to participate in the biobank
